card.name: Sub and deep starting medical phrases
card.fires_on: The word 'sub' (or 'Sub', 'deep') at the start of a phrase in drug-label warnings, especially 'A sub' before 'population' in the aspirin-sensitivity asthma section.

modes.label: A sub|population
modes.description: The word 'sub' after 'A' at the start of the aspirin-sensitivity asthma warning, just before 'population'.
modes.example: 5.8 Exacerbation of Asthma Related to Aspirin Sensitivity A<< sub>>population of patients with asthma may have aspir

modes.label: Other starts of phrases
modes.description: 'deep' or 'Sub' beginning a medical term such as deep vein thrombosis or Substantially.
modes.example: including pulmonary embolism,<< deep>> vein thrombosis, retinal vein

card.plain: It fires on the word 'sub' or 'deep' when it begins a phrase in a drug warning, mainly 'A subpopulation of patients'.
